news.headline: Why Is Alphabet Stock Sinking Thursday?
news.summary: Alphabet stock dropped 10% premarket after missing Q3 earnings and revenue estimates amid slowing Search growth and rising AI spend.

news.headline: GOOGL Stock Headed for Worst Single-Day Decline in Over Six Years as Waymo, Other Bets Widens Q3 Loss to Over $2 Billion
news.summary: Waymo surpasses 300M autonomous miles and plans global expansion, but widening losses continue to plague Other Bets division.

news.headline: Google Search Revenue Growth Slows Despite 5-Year High in Queries as AI Search Struggles to Match Traditional Ads: ‘We Feel Very Good’
news.summary: Google says record Search query growth is being offset by weaker monetization of AI-powered search, while expanding AI ads.

news.headline: Kong Joins ServiceNow Control Tower Alliance
news.summary: Kong Inc. has become a founding member of the ServiceNow Control Tower Alliance to help enterprises secure and govern AI applications.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Reiterates Overweight on ServiceNow, Maintains $175 Price Target
HPE Selects ServiceNow for Cloud & AI Support Services
news.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has entered a five-year agreement to utilize the ServiceNow AI Platform as the foundation for its Cloud & AI business support services.

news.headline: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Announces CFO Transition
news.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. has appointed Meghan Montana, the current Chief Strategy Officer, as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective January 1, 2027.

news.headline: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. reported third-quarter 2026 financial results, exceeding analyst expectations for both revenue and adjusted earnings per share.

news.headline: Norwegian Cruise Line Appoints Meghan Montana, Current Chief Strategy Officer, as CFO, Effective January 1, 2027, Succeeding Mark Kempa, Who Will Step Down Following Over 25 Years of Service to Norwegian.
Marvell in Advanced Talks to Acquire Lumentum
news.summary: Marvell Technology is reportedly in advanced negotiations to acquire optical networking company Lumentum Holdings.

news.headline: 'Marvell Said to Near Megadeal for Lumentum In AI Push'- Bloomberg
ServiceNow Posts Downbeat Q3 Earnings, Joins Sprouts Farmers Market, Alphabet And Other Big Stocks Moving Lower In Thursday’s Pre-Market Session
